title: Finite-site realization and transport of the coordinate normalization
statement:
Fix the finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions], a separated finite-type k-scheme T that is Noetherian, and an invertible Cartier ideal for its affine zero section. CartierRealization [def-pur-coordinate-section-cartier-realization] holds with one supported-source comparison for all annihilating exponents. Moreover, at each allowed exponent and invertibility witness, OrdinaryNormalization [def-pur-coordinate-section-ordinary-arrows] and CoprojectionNormalization [def-pur-coordinate-section-coprojection-arrows] imply ProNormalization [def-pur-coordinate-section-site-arrows]. All Tate inputs have the required finite-Tor constructibility, bounded compared origins, proper projection and middle comparison unit isomorphisms; their actual proOrientation and gammaCoordinates are isomorphisms and their composite with the specified proComposition is identity. The ordinary normalization is a hypothesis, not a conclusion.

The exact Lean statement is:

theorem coordinateSectionSiteTransport
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (aT : T ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aT] [QuasiCompact aT] [IsSeparated aT] [IsNoetherian T]
    (hI : (sectionMap T).ker.IsInvertible) :
    CartierRealization T P aT hI ∧
    ∀ (b : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1) : ℕ) : Ring P) = 0)
      (hT : IsUnit ((P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryNormalization (Ring P) T (P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : P.coefficients.l.Prime).pos _) hA hT hI →
      CoprojectionNormalization (Ring P) T (P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : P.coefficients.l.Prime).pos _) hA hT hI →
      ProNormalization T P b hA aT hT hI

source.place: Rank-one supported Cartier normalization, even twists and finite etale-origin transport; expanded parent proof steps as specified below.

proof.text: Apply the published Cartier Kummer map theorem to the coordinate zero divisor. Boundary uniqueness identifies its ordinary family with ordinaryClass. Its supported-constant unit is epic, so the normalized source comparison is independent of exponent. The finite Tate root projection fixes the target as twistDerived. Pass through Ext.hom and the exact-image/single and comparison/single isomorphisms. This gives CartierRealization with exactly cartierSource, uniformly over the allowed exponents; a common larger exponent gives the same published map.

The finite twist lines and their even shifts are finite-Tor constructible and bounded. Finite-origin full faithfulness makes middleUnit invertible on the relevant ordinary exceptional value. The coordinate-line adjunction and vector-integration comparison identify the actual transported transpose as gammaCoordinates. The closed counit transport identifies the actual closed adjunction, while closed-section compact origin identifies the normalized supported source.

Compact-support site coherence and conjugation identify the ordinary exceptional composition with proComposition, including inverse middleUnit and the comparison counit. Apply comparison to the assumed ordinary exceptional equation, cancel adjacent units/counits, and retain the given coprojection orientation. This proves the literal pro-etale equation and transports isomorphy. Treat the unit input separately and each Tate input with its bounded witness.
